strings.scene.yuan.chengjisi.title: 成吉思汗
strings.scene.yuan.chengjisi.subtitle: 斡难河源
strings.vo.01: 十二世纪末，蒙古草原诸部相争。乞颜部的铁木真少年丧父，部众离散。
strings.vo.02: 妻子孛儿帖被蔑儿乞人掳去，他联合义父王汗与安答札木合，将她夺回。
strings.vo.03: 此后他与札木合反目，又与王汗决裂，先后击败克烈、乃蛮诸部。
strings.vo.04: 1206 年，诸部首领会于斡难河源，竖起九斿白纛。
strings.vo.05: 他被推为大汗，号成吉思汗——
strings.scene.yuan.chengjisi.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.yuan.chengjisi.pick.canon: 正史 · 《元史》、《蒙古秘史》所载
strings.scene.yuan.chengjisi.canon.intro: 丙寅年春，斡难河源头。九斿白旗竖起来了，各部的首领陆续到齐。
strings.scene.yuan.chengjisi.end.canon: 成吉思汗以千户制组织诸部，蒙古由此兴起。
strings.scene.yuan.chengjisi.legend.disclaimer: 以下出自《蒙古秘史》的祖先传说，带有浓厚的传说色彩。
strings.scene.yuan.chengjisi.legend.intro: 《蒙古秘史》说：蒙古先祖之母阿兰豁阿给五个儿子每人一支箭，让他们折断，都轻易折断了；又把五支箭捆在一起，就没有人能折断。
strings.scene.yuan.chengjisi.end.legend: 一捆箭的道理传了下来。传说汇回正史：诸部合一，成吉思汗称汗。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

narration: 十二世纪末，蒙古草原诸部相争。乞颜部的铁木真少年丧父，部众离散。妻子孛儿帖被蔑儿乞人掳去，他联合义父王汗与安答札木合，将她夺回。
此后他与札木合反目，又与王汗决裂，先后击败克烈、乃蛮诸部。
1206 年，诸部首领会于斡难河源，竖起九斿白纛。
他被推为大汗，号成吉思汗——
成吉思汗以千户制组织诸部，蒙古由此兴起。

strings.scene.yuan.xizheng.title: 西征
strings.scene.yuan.xizheng.subtitle: 成吉思汗与长春真人
strings.vo.01: 成吉思汗派往花剌子模的商队，在讹答剌城被守将杀害，财物被夺。他再派使者交涉，使者也被杀了。
strings.vo.02: 太祖十四年夏，成吉思汗亲率大军西征。讹答剌、不花剌、撒马尔罕相继陷落，战火所及，屠戮惨烈。
strings.vo.03: 算端摩诃末一路西逃，者别、速不台紧追不舍，摩诃末最后病死在里海的一个小岛上。
strings.vo.04: 他的儿子札兰丁且战且退，在申河岸边被蒙古军追上。
strings.vo.05: 与此同时，一位七十多岁的道士，正从山东出发，一路向西——
strings.scene.yuan.xizheng.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.yuan.xizheng.canon.intro: 讹答剌城外，一支四百多人的商队刚刚卸下骆驼。城门上，守将正在打量他们的货物。
strings.scene.yuan.xizheng.end.canon: 札兰丁跃马渡河而去，成吉思汗称其有子如此。西征历时六七年，花剌子模覆灭。丘处机劝以敬天爱民、清心寡欲，成吉思汗命左右记下。太祖二十年，大军东还。
strings.scene.yuan.xizheng.pick.legend: 行记 · 长春真人西游记
strings.scene.yuan.xizheng.legend.disclaimer: 以下取丘处机弟子李志常所撰《长春真人西游记》。书中所记是师徒一行万里西行的亲身见闻，可信度较高，但所述对话经弟子整理，带有道家立场。
strings.scene.yuan.xizheng.legend.intro: 《西游记》写道：真人一行出居庸关，过草原、越金山，沿途风俗、山川、气候，一一记下。走了一年多，才到成吉思汗的行营。
strings.scene.yuan.xizheng.end.legend: 世上没有长生药，只有卫生之道。行记与正史在雪山行宫汇流。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 元 · 元太祖十四年至二十年（1219—1225 年）。大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船。
setting.en: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1219 CE–1225 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

narration: 成吉思汗派往花剌子模的商队，在讹答剌城被守将杀害，财物被夺。他再派使者交涉，使者也被杀了。太祖十四年夏，成吉思汗亲率大军西征。讹答剌、不花剌、撒马尔罕相继陷落，战火所及，屠戮惨烈。
算端摩诃末一路西逃，者别、速不台紧追不舍，摩诃末最后病死在里海的一个小岛上。
他的儿子札兰丁且战且退，在申河岸边被蒙古军追上。
与此同时，一位七十多岁的道士，正从山东出发，一路向西——

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Yuan dynasty (1271–1368) · "西征" (成吉思汗与长春真人)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1219 CE–1225 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

Characters:
- Temüjin (铁木真) — ruler, 蒙古 camp; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots; age as historically attested in 1219 CE–1225 CE
- Jebe (者别) — general, 蒙古 camp; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots; age as historically attested in 1219 CE–1225 CE
- Jalal al-Din (札兰丁) — royal / consort, 花剌子模 camp; Central Asian Islamic dress: turban, long robe, scimitar; age as historically attested in 1219 CE–1225 CE
- Qiu Chuji (丘处机) — scholar, 全真道 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; age as historically attested in 1219 CE–1225 CE
- Su Butai (速不台) — general, 蒙古 camp; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots; age as historically attested in 1219 CE–1225 CE
- Mo Hemo (摩诃末) — ruler, 花剌子模 camp; Central Asian Islamic dress: turban, long robe, scimitar; age as historically attested in 1219 CE–1225 CE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, sand; subject: crowd | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 讹答剌城，商队的驼铃 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「西征」 with vermilion seal 「西征」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: army ranks, forest of spears, cavalry; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 蒙古大军越过阿尔泰山 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「成吉思汗派往花剌子模的商队，在讹答剌城被守将杀害，财物被夺。他再派使者交涉，使者也被杀了。太祖十四年夏，成吉思汗亲率大军西征。讹答剌、不花剌、撒马尔罕相继陷落，战火所及，屠戮惨烈。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: sea, breaking waves; subject: Jebe, cavalry | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 者别、速不台追击摩诃末 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「算端摩诃末一路西逃，者别、速不台紧追不舍，摩诃末最后病死在里海的一个小岛上。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river; subject: Jalal al-Din, war horse; dry-brush calligraphy 「申河」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 申河岸边，札兰丁跃马入河 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: surging water | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他的儿子札兰丁且战且退，在申河岸边被蒙古军追上。」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Qiu Chuji, Temüjin; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 大雪山行宫，丘处机进言 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: hoofbeats, rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「与此同时，一位七十多岁的道士，正从山东出发，一路向西——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Qiu Chuji, Temüjin | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 札兰丁跃马渡河而去，成吉思汗称其有子如此。西征历时六七年，花剌子模覆灭。丘处机劝以敬天爱民、清心寡欲，成吉思汗命左右记下。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「札兰丁跃马渡河而去，成吉思汗称其有子如此。西征历时六七年，花剌子模覆灭。丘处机劝以敬天爱民、清心寡欲，成吉思汗命左右记下。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「西征」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: morin khuur horse-head fiddle, vast steppe mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, distant battle, quiet room tone; SFX: footsteps, hoofbeats, surging water, rustling silk; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「西征」, subtitle 「成吉思汗与长春真人」, vermilion seal 「西征」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

strings.scene.yuan.yelvchucai.title: 治天下匠
strings.scene.yuan.yelvchucai.subtitle: 耶律楚材
strings.vo.01: 耶律楚材是契丹皇族之后，身长八尺，长须垂胸。成吉思汗称他为“吾图撒合里”，意思是长胡子的人。
strings.vo.02: 窝阔台即位后，近臣别迭等人说：汉人对国家没有用处，可以把他们全部清除，把田地改作牧场。
strings.vo.03: 耶律楚材说：陛下将要南伐，军需总要有个来处。若均定中原的地税、商税和盐、酒、铁冶、山泽之利，每年可得银五十万两、帛八万匹、粟四十多万石。
strings.vo.04: 西夏人常八斤以造弓得宠，常说：国家正在用武，要儒者做什么？耶律楚材答道——
strings.vo.05: 第二年，十路课税使把账簿和金帛陈列在殿庭之上——
strings.scene.yuan.yelvchucai.quote: 治弓尚须用弓匠，为天下者岂可不用治天下匠耶？
strings.scene.yuan.yelvchucai.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.yuan.yelvchucai.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《元史·耶律楚材传》所载
strings.scene.yuan.yelvchucai.canon.intro: 一场辩论决定了千万人的生死：汉地是改作牧场，还是收税治理？
strings.scene.yuan.yelvchucai.end.canon: 窝阔台看到满庭的金帛与仓簿，笑着说：你不离我左右，就能让国用充足，南国的臣子，还有像你这样的吗？当天就拜他为中书令。
strings.scene.yuan.yelvchucai.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《元史·耶律楚材传》所载角端一事：成吉思汗西征至东印度铁门关，遇一角兽，形如鹿而马尾，色绿，作人言曰“汝主宜早还”，楚材说这是瑞兽角端，好生恶杀，是上天的告诫，成吉思汗即日班师。此事虽载于正史，显系神异附会。并参照蔡东藩《元史演义》第十四回“见角端西域班师”。
strings.scene.yuan.yelvchucai.legend.intro: 铁门关外，一头绿色的独角兽拦住了大军的去路，开口说了一句人话。
strings.scene.yuan.yelvchucai.end.legend: 角端劝住了西征，账册保住了中原。都是同一个长胡子的人。汇流。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

镜头 6（90–100 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：窝阔台｜动作：正史结局：窝阔台看到满庭的金帛与仓簿，笑着说：你不离我左右，就能让国用充足，南国的臣子，还有像你这样的吗？当天就拜他为中书令。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「窝阔台看到满庭的金帛与仓簿，笑着说：你不离我左右，就能让国用充足，南国的臣子，还有像你这样的吗？当天就拜他为中书令。」
镜头 7（100–106 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「治弓尚须用弓匠，为天下者岂可不用治天下匠耶？」，下署《元史·耶律楚材传》；右下角朱印「课税」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「治弓尚须用弓匠，为天下者岂可不用治天下匠耶？」

声音：背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：人群低语、寂静室内、宫殿回响；音效：风声、低语、竹简翻动、弦断、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「治天下匠」，副题「耶律楚材」，朱印「课税」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「治弓尚须用弓匠，为天下者岂可不用治天下匠耶？」——《元史·耶律楚材传》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Yuan dynasty (1271–1368) · "治天下匠" (耶律楚材)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1229 CE–1231 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

Characters:
- Yelü Chucai (耶律楚材) — minister, 蒙古 camp; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots; age as historically attested in 1229 CE–1231 CE
- Ögedei (窝阔台) — ruler, 蒙古 camp; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots; age as historically attested in 1229 CE–1231 CE
- Biedie (别迭) — minister, 蒙古 camp; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots; age as historically attested in 1229 CE–1231 CE
- Chang Bajin (常八斤) — commoner, 蒙古 camp; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots; age as historically attested in 1229 CE–1231 CE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: banners, crowd | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 草原上的大帐，众臣议论如何处置新得的汉地 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「治天下匠」 with vermilion seal 「课税」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Biedie | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 一个近臣说：汉人无用，不如把他们赶走，田地改成牧场 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「耶律楚材是契丹皇族之后，身长八尺，长须垂胸。成吉思汗称他为“吾图撒合里”，意思是长胡子的人。窝阔台即位后，近臣别迭等人说：汉人对国家没有用处，可以把他们全部清除，把田地改作牧场。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: scroll, 课税; subject: Yelü Chucai | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 一个长须的契丹人站起来，展开一卷账册 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「治弓尚须用弓匠，为天下者岂可不用治天下匠耶？」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「耶律楚材说：陛下将要南伐，军需总要有个来处。若均定中原的地税、商税和盐、酒、铁冶、山泽之利，每年可得银五十万两、帛八万匹、粟四十多万石。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Chang Bajin, Yelü Chucai, bow | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 弓匠举着一张弓，问儒者有什么用 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: snapping string | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「西夏人常八斤以造弓得宠，常说：国家正在用武，要儒者做什么？耶律楚材答道——」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Ögedei, crowd; dry-brush calligraphy 「中书令」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 一年后，十路税使把金帛与仓簿陈列于殿庭 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「第二年，十路课税使把账簿和金帛陈列在殿庭之上——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Ögedei | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 窝阔台看到满庭的金帛与仓簿，笑着说：你不离我左右，就能让国用充足，南国的臣子，还有像你这样的吗？当天就拜他为中书令。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「窝阔台看到满庭的金帛与仓簿，笑着说：你不离我左右，就能让国用充足，南国的臣子，还有像你这样的吗？当天就拜他为中书令。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「治弓尚须用弓匠，为天下者岂可不用治天下匠耶？」 signed 《元史·耶律楚材传》; vermilion seal 「课税」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「治弓尚须用弓匠，为天下者岂可不用治天下匠耶？」

Sound: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: crowd murmur, quiet room tone, palace hall reverb; SFX: wind, murmuring, bamboo slips rustling, snapping string, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「治天下匠」, subtitle 「耶律楚材」, vermilion seal 「课税」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「治弓尚须用弓匠，为天下者岂可不用治天下匠耶？」 — 《元史·耶律楚材传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

strings.scene.yuan.zhiyuan.title: 至元
strings.scene.yuan.zhiyuan.subtitle: 忽必烈建元
strings.vo.01: 蒙哥死于四川，诸王争立。忽必烈从鄂州前线北返。
strings.vo.02: 1260 年，他在开平即大汗位，建元中统。几乎同时，阿里不哥在和林也被拥立为大汗。
strings.vo.03: 兄弟相争四年，阿里不哥兵败投降。
strings.vo.04: 忽必烈任用刘秉忠等人，营建都城，参用汉法。
strings.vo.05: 至元八年，取《易经》“大哉乾元”之义——
strings.scene.yuan.zhiyuan.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.yuan.zhiyuan.canon.intro: 至元八年十一月，忽必烈命刘秉忠等议定国号，取《易经》“大哉乾元”之义。
strings.scene.yuan.zhiyuan.end.canon: 定国号为大元。数年后迁都大都，1279 年灭宋，天下一统。
strings.scene.yuan.zhiyuan.pick.legend: 野史 · 马可·波罗的大汗
strings.scene.yuan.zhiyuan.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自《马可·波罗行纪》。这部书的叙述多有夸张，马可·波罗是否到过中国，学界仍有争议。
strings.scene.yuan.zhiyuan.legend.intro: 《行纪》描述大汗的宫殿、驿站与纸币，说大汗的宫殿是世上最大的宫殿，大汗出猎时随从无数。
strings.scene.yuan.zhiyuan.end.legend: 一个外乡人的描述，与史书相互映照。传说汇回正史：大元建立。
strings.scene.yuan.zhiyuan.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若阿里不哥胜出（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Yuan dynasty (1271–1368) · "至元" (忽必烈建元)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1260 CE–1271 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

Characters:
- Kublai (忽必烈) — ruler, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 1260 CE–1271 CE
- Ariq Böke (阿里不哥) — royal / consort, 蒙古 camp; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots; age as historically attested in 1260 CE–1271 CE
- Liu Bingzhong (刘秉忠) — minister, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 1260 CE–1271 CE
- Yao Shu (姚枢) — minister, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 1260 CE–1271 CE
- Cha Bi (察必) — royal / consort, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; age as historically attested in 1260 CE–1271 CE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: grass, crenellated city wall | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 开平城，草原与农田的交界 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: steppe wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「至元」 with vermilion seal 「大元」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Kublai, war horse; dry-brush calligraphy 「雨」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 蒙哥死讯传来 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: light rain; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「蒙哥死于四川，诸王争立。忽必烈从鄂州前线北返。1260 年，他在开平即大汗位，建元中统。几乎同时，阿里不哥在和林也被拥立为大汗。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Ariq Böke, banners | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 两汗并立：开平与和林 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「兄弟相争四年，阿里不哥兵败投降。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: cavalry, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 四年之争 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: clashing weapons | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「忽必烈任用刘秉忠等人，营建都城，参用汉法。」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 元; dry-brush calligraphy 「建元」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 大哉乾元 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「至元八年，取《易经》“大哉乾元”之义——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 定国号为大元。数年后迁都大都，1279 年灭宋，天下一统。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「定国号为大元。数年后迁都大都，1279 年灭宋，天下一统。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「大元」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: morin khuur horse-head fiddle, vast steppe mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, light rain, distant battle, lingering wind after battle; SFX: hoofbeats, horn, clashing weapons, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「至元」, subtitle 「忽必烈建元」, vermilion seal 「大元」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.yuan.dadu.title: 大都
strings.scene.yuan.dadu.subtitle: 刘秉忠
strings.vo.01: 忽必烈决定定都燕京。金中都在战火中已残破不堪，他命刘秉忠在旧城东北另筑新城。
strings.vo.02: 刘秉忠年轻时做过僧人，精通易学与天文地理。他以积水潭的湖泊为中心，规划出一座方正的大城。
strings.vo.03: 至元四年正月始筑。新城开十一座门，宫城、皇城沿中轴线布置，左祖右社，前朝后市，取法《周礼·考工记》。
strings.vo.04: 至元八年，刘秉忠建议以《易经》“大哉乾元”定国号为“大元”。次年，中都改称大都。
strings.vo.05: 后来，郭守敬引昌平白浮泉水，绕山入城，开通惠河——
strings.scene.yuan.dadu.quote: 大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。
strings.scene.yuan.dadu.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.yuan.dadu.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《元史·刘秉忠传》《世祖纪》所载
strings.scene.yuan.dadu.canon.intro: 今天北京城的中轴线，最早就是在这块荒地上画下的。
strings.scene.yuan.dadu.end.canon: 大都城周回六十里，十一门。至元三十年，通惠河开通，江南漕船直抵积水潭，忽必烈过万宁桥见舳舻蔽水，大悦。明清北京城即在大都的基础上改建。
strings.scene.yuan.dadu.legend.disclaimer: 以下取元末明初长谷真逸《农田余话》所载：燕城系刘太保（秉忠）定制，凡十一门，作哪吒神三头六臂两足。后世北京民间又有刘伯温、姚广孝画“八臂哪吒城”的传说。这是附会，城门数目实为规划所需。
strings.scene.yuan.dadu.legend.intro: 传说刘秉忠为了镇住燕京的苦海孽龙，把大都设计成哪吒的模样：南面三门是三个头，东西各三门是六条臂，北面两门是两只脚。
strings.scene.yuan.dadu.end.legend: 传说里的城是哪吒，史书里的城是《考工记》。都是一座方方正正的大都。汇流。

画风：写意水墨，焦墨—浓墨—淡墨分层次，枯笔飞白与泼墨墨点飞溅，笔触边缘自然晕开；点缀色（用量克制，只作点睛）：黑色 #1a1a1a、卡其色 #a5a293、深蓝色 #3950c0。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：4×4 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 远山（淡墨）；2. 近坡（中墨）；3. 土坡地线；4. 草丛（枯笔）。
第 2 行：5. 大江水面；6. 白色飞白浪花；7. 涟漪；8. 河渠。
第 3 行：9. 堤坝；10. 木石料；11. 山石；12. 城墙雉堞。
第 4 行：13. 关门；14. 留空；15. 留空；16. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：2048×2048 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 元 · 元至元四年至十三年（1267—1276 年）。大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船。
setting.en: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1267 CE–1276 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

characters.name: 刘秉忠
characters.zh: 刘秉忠（元·太保，原为僧人子聪）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；年龄依史实（此时为1267—1276 年）；规划上都与大都，建议国号“大元”
characters.en: Liu Bingzhong (刘秉忠) — minister, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 1267 CE–1276 CE

characters.name: 郭守敬
characters.zh: 郭守敬（元·都水监）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；年龄依史实（此时为1267—1276 年）；引白浮泉水，开通惠河，漕船直达大都
characters.en: Guo Shoujing (郭守敬) — scholar, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; age as historically attested in 1267 CE–1276 CE

characters.name: 忽必烈
characters.zh: 忽必烈（元·元世祖）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；年龄依史实（此时为1267—1276 年）；定都燕京，命秉忠筑城
characters.en: Kublai (忽必烈) — ruler, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 1267 CE–1276 CE

characters.name: 也黑迭儿
characters.zh: 也黑迭儿（元·茶迪儿匠人）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；年龄依史实（此时为1267—1276 年）；主持宫殿营造
characters.en: Ye Heidieer (也黑迭儿) — commoner, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in 1267 CE–1276 CE

shots.vo: 忽必烈决定定都燕京。金中都在战火中已残破不堪，他命刘秉忠在旧城东北另筑新城。刘秉忠年轻时做过僧人，精通易学与天文地理。他以积水潭的湖泊为中心，规划出一座方正的大城。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–26 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：城、地图卷；主体：刘秉忠｜动作：一个曾经做过和尚的老人，在地上画出一个方正的城｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「忽必烈决定定都燕京。金中都在战火中已残破不堪，他命刘秉忠在旧城东北另筑新城。刘秉忠年轻时做过僧人，精通易学与天文地理。他以积水潭的湖泊为中心，规划出一座方正的大城。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: 城, map scroll; subject: Liu Bingzhong | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 一个曾经做过和尚的老人，在地上画出一个方正的城 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「忽必烈决定定都燕京。金中都在战火中已残破不堪，他命刘秉忠在旧城东北另筑新城。刘秉忠年轻时做过僧人，精通易学与天文地理。他以积水潭的湖泊为中心，规划出一座方正的大城。」

shots.vo: 至元四年正月始筑。新城开十一座门，宫城、皇城沿中轴线布置，左祖右社，前朝后市，取法《周礼·考工记》。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（26–50 秒，24 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、关门；主体：盾墙、水｜动作：十一座城门，一条中轴线，宫城环绕湖水而建｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：凿石｜屏幕文字：引文「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「至元四年正月始筑。新城开十一座门，宫城、皇城沿中轴线布置，左祖右社，前朝后市，取法《周礼·考工记》。」

shots.vo: 至元八年，刘秉忠建议以《易经》“大哉乾元”定国号为“大元”。次年，中都改称大都。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（50–78 秒，28 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：河水、近山与地面；主体：郭守敬｜动作：白浮泉的水沿着山脚绕了一个大弯，流进城里｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：水势奔涌｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「至元八年，刘秉忠建议以《易经》“大哉乾元”定国号为“大元”。次年，中都改称大都。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river, near hills and ground; subject: Guo Shoujing | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 白浮泉的水沿着山脚绕了一个大弯，流进城里 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: surging water | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「至元八年，刘秉忠建议以《易经》“大哉乾元”定国号为“大元”。次年，中都改称大都。」

shots.vo: 后来，郭守敬引昌平白浮泉水，绕山入城，开通惠河——

shots.en: Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: boat, crenellated city wall; subject: water; dry-brush calligraphy 「大都」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 漕船驶入积水潭，帆樯如林 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: chiselling stone | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「后来，郭守敬引昌平白浮泉水，绕山入城，开通惠河——」

shots.vo: 大都城周回六十里，十一门。至元三十年，通惠河开通，江南漕船直抵积水潭，忽必烈过万宁桥见舳舻蔽水，大悦。明清北京城即在大都的基础上改建。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（90–100 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：大都城周回六十里，十一门。至元三十年，通惠河开通，江南漕船直抵积水潭，忽必烈过万宁桥见舳舻蔽水，大悦。明清北京城即在大都的基础上改建。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「大都城周回六十里，十一门。至元三十年，通惠河开通，江南漕船直抵积水潭，忽必烈过万宁桥见舳舻蔽水，大悦。明清北京城即在大都的基础上改建。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 大都城周回六十里，十一门。至元三十年，通惠河开通，江南漕船直抵积水潭，忽必烈过万宁桥见舳舻蔽水，大悦。明清北京城即在大都的基础上改建。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「大都城周回六十里，十一门。至元三十年，通惠河开通，江南漕船直抵积水潭，忽必烈过万宁桥见舳舻蔽水，大悦。明清北京城即在大都的基础上改建。」

shots.vo: 大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（100–106 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」，下署《周易·乾·彖传》；右下角朱印「大都」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」 signed 《周易·乾·彖传》; vermilion seal 「大都」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、人群低语、平缓河水、众人呐喊；音效：风声、竹简翻动、凿石、水势奔涌；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, crowd murmur, calm river, roaring crowd; SFX: wind, bamboo slips rustling, chiselling stone, surging water; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「大都」，副题「刘秉忠」，朱印「大都」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」——《周易·乾·彖传》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「大都」, subtitle 「刘秉忠」, vermilion seal 「大都」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」 — 《周易·乾·彖传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】元 · 大都（刘秉忠）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 106 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。

时代与场景：元 · 元至元四年至十三年（1267—1276 年）。大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船。

人物：
- 刘秉忠（元·太保，原为僧人子聪）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；年龄依史实（此时为1267—1276 年）；规划上都与大都，建议国号“大元”
- 郭守敬（元·都水监）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；年龄依史实（此时为1267—1276 年）；引白浮泉水，开通惠河，漕船直达大都
- 忽必烈（元·元世祖）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；年龄依史实（此时为1267—1276 年）；定都燕京，命秉忠筑城
- 也黑迭儿（元·茶迪儿匠人）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；年龄依史实（此时为1267—1276 年）；主持宫殿营造

分镜：
镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面；主体：水｜动作：金中都的废墟旁，一片湖泊与荒地｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：风声｜屏幕文字：片名「大都」竖排书法与朱印「大都」
镜头 2（10–26 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：城、地图卷；主体：刘秉忠｜动作：一个曾经做过和尚的老人，在地上画出一个方正的城｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「忽必烈决定定都燕京。金中都在战火中已残破不堪，他命刘秉忠在旧城东北另筑新城。刘秉忠年轻时做过僧人，精通易学与天文地理。他以积水潭的湖泊为中心，规划出一座方正的大城。」
镜头 3（26–50 秒，24 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、关门；主体：盾墙、水｜动作：十一座城门，一条中轴线，宫城环绕湖水而建｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：凿石｜屏幕文字：引文「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「至元四年正月始筑。新城开十一座门，宫城、皇城沿中轴线布置，左祖右社，前朝后市，取法《周礼·考工记》。」
镜头 4（50–78 秒，28 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：河水、近山与地面；主体：郭守敬｜动作：白浮泉的水沿着山脚绕了一个大弯，流进城里｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：水势奔涌｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「至元八年，刘秉忠建议以《易经》“大哉乾元”定国号为“大元”。次年，中都改称大都。」
镜头 5（78–90 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：舟、城墙雉堞；主体：水；飞白题字「大都」｜动作：漕船驶入积水潭，帆樯如林｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：众人呐喊；音效：凿石｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「后来，郭守敬引昌平白浮泉水，绕山入城，开通惠河——」
镜头 6（90–100 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：大都城周回六十里，十一门。至元三十年，通惠河开通，江南漕船直抵积水潭，忽必烈过万宁桥见舳舻蔽水，大悦。明清北京城即在大都的基础上改建。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「大都城周回六十里，十一门。至元三十年，通惠河开通，江南漕船直抵积水潭，忽必烈过万宁桥见舳舻蔽水，大悦。明清北京城即在大都的基础上改建。」
镜头 7（100–106 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」，下署《周易·乾·彖传》；右下角朱印「大都」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」

声音：背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、人群低语、平缓河水、众人呐喊；音效：风声、竹简翻动、凿石、水势奔涌；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「大都」，副题「刘秉忠」，朱印「大都」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」——《周易·乾·彖传》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Yuan dynasty (1271–1368) · "大都" (刘秉忠)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1267 CE–1276 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

Characters:
- Liu Bingzhong (刘秉忠) — minister, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 1267 CE–1276 CE
- Guo Shoujing (郭守敬) — scholar, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; age as historically attested in 1267 CE–1276 CE
- Kublai (忽必烈) — ruler, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 1267 CE–1276 CE
- Ye Heidieer (也黑迭儿) — commoner, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in 1267 CE–1276 CE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: water | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 金中都的废墟旁，一片湖泊与荒地 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「大都」 with vermilion seal 「大都」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: 城, map scroll; subject: Liu Bingzhong | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 一个曾经做过和尚的老人，在地上画出一个方正的城 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「忽必烈决定定都燕京。金中都在战火中已残破不堪，他命刘秉忠在旧城东北另筑新城。刘秉忠年轻时做过僧人，精通易学与天文地理。他以积水潭的湖泊为中心，规划出一座方正的大城。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, gate; subject: shield wall, water | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 十一座城门，一条中轴线，宫城环绕湖水而建 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: chiselling stone | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「至元四年正月始筑。新城开十一座门，宫城、皇城沿中轴线布置，左祖右社，前朝后市，取法《周礼·考工记》。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river, near hills and ground; subject: Guo Shoujing | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 白浮泉的水沿着山脚绕了一个大弯，流进城里 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: surging water | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「至元八年，刘秉忠建议以《易经》“大哉乾元”定国号为“大元”。次年，中都改称大都。」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: boat, crenellated city wall; subject: water; dry-brush calligraphy 「大都」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 漕船驶入积水潭，帆樯如林 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: chiselling stone | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「后来，郭守敬引昌平白浮泉水，绕山入城，开通惠河——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 大都城周回六十里，十一门。至元三十年，通惠河开通，江南漕船直抵积水潭，忽必烈过万宁桥见舳舻蔽水，大悦。明清北京城即在大都的基础上改建。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「大都城周回六十里，十一门。至元三十年，通惠河开通，江南漕船直抵积水潭，忽必烈过万宁桥见舳舻蔽水，大悦。明清北京城即在大都的基础上改建。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」 signed 《周易·乾·彖传》; vermilion seal 「大都」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」

Sound: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, crowd murmur, calm river, roaring crowd; SFX: wind, bamboo slips rustling, chiselling stone, surging water; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「大都」, subtitle 「刘秉忠」, vermilion seal 「大都」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「大哉乾元，万物资始，乃统天。」 — 《周易·乾·彖传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.yuan.shenfeng.title: 渡海东征
strings.scene.yuan.shenfeng.subtitle: 元征日本
strings.vo.01: 忽必烈多次遣使日本，要日本通好，都没有得到答复。
strings.vo.02: 至元十一年，忻都率蒙汉高丽军渡海东征，在博多湾登陆，初战小胜，却因矢尽而撤回。
strings.vo.03: 至元十八年，元军再次东征，东路军自高丽出发，江南军十万人由范文虎率领从庆元出海。
strings.vo.04: 两路大军会合后，移泊平户、五龙山一带。八月初一，飓风骤起。
strings.vo.05: 船与船互相撞击，碎了一大半——
strings.scene.yuan.shenfeng.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.anchor.guoshu: 忽必烈遣使赍国书往日本
strings.scene.yuan.shenfeng.canon.intro: 至元十八年夏，庆元港。江南军的战船一艘接一艘驶出港口，船上多是南宋的降卒。
strings.scene.yuan.shenfeng.end.canon: 风灾之后，范文虎等择坚船先遁，弃十余万士卒于岛上，后多被杀或被俘。《元史》说，十万之众，得还者仅三人。忽必烈此后仍有再征之意，终因民力不堪而罢。
strings.scene.yuan.shenfeng.pick.legend: 后世 · 日本方面的神风叙事
strings.scene.yuan.shenfeng.legend.disclaimer: 以下取日本方面的记载与后世叙事。镰仓时代后期的寺社文献《八幡愚童训》等把风灾说成神佛护国的“神风”，这是宗教与后世的叙述，不是当时的战报。
strings.scene.yuan.shenfeng.legend.intro: 日本寺社的记载说：元军来时，各地寺社日夜祈祷，忽然大风从海上吹来，敌船尽没，人们称之为神风。
strings.scene.yuan.shenfeng.end.legend: 一场飓风，在两边留下了两种记忆。汇流。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

narration: 忽必烈多次遣使日本，要日本通好，都没有得到答复。至元十一年，忻都率蒙汉高丽军渡海东征，在博多湾登陆，初战小胜，却因矢尽而撤回。
至元十八年，元军再次东征，东路军自高丽出发，江南军十万人由范文虎率领从庆元出海。
两路大军会合后，移泊平户、五龙山一带。八月初一，飓风骤起。
船与船互相撞击，碎了一大半——
风灾之后，范文虎等择坚船先遁，弃十余万士卒于岛上，后多被杀或被俘。《元史》说，十万之众，得还者仅三人。

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1281 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

Characters:

- Kublai (忽必烈) — ruler, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 1281 CE
- Xin Dou (忻都) — general, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; age as historically attested in 1281 CE

strings.scene.yuan.shoushi.title: 授时历
strings.scene.yuan.shoushi.subtitle: 郭守敬
strings.vo.01: 宋金以来沿用的旧历，已经和天象差了不少。江南平定后，世祖命郭守敬与王恂修订新历。
strings.vo.02: 郭守敬说：历之本在于测验，而测验之器莫先于仪表。太史院的旧浑仪是宋代从汴京运来的，早已不准。
strings.vo.03: 他重新设计了简仪、仰仪、高表等十几种仪器。高表比旧表高出数倍，日影更加清楚。
strings.vo.04: 至元十六年，他奏请在全国设二十七处观测点，南到南海，北到北海，同时测量。
strings.vo.05: 数年间的数据汇到太史院，王恂一笔一笔地推算——
strings.scene.yuan.shoushi.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.yuan.shoushi.pick.canon: 正史 · 《元史·郭守敬传》《历志》所载
strings.scene.yuan.shoushi.canon.intro: 至元十六年，大都太史院。郭守敬把一张地图铺在桌上，上面圈出了二十七个地点，最南的一个在海中。
strings.scene.yuan.shoushi.end.canon: 至元十七年冬新历告成，世祖赐名授时历，次年颁行。授时历以三百六十五日又二四二五为一岁，与今公历所用数值相同。晚年郭守敬又主持开凿通惠河，漕船可直抵大都积水潭。
strings.scene.yuan.shoushi.legend.disclaimer: 以下以河南登封告成镇现存的元代观星台为线索。观星台一般认为是四海测验时所建的测景台，是郭守敬高表测影之法的实物遗存；具体测量细节为本作推想。
strings.scene.yuan.shoushi.legend.intro: 登封告成镇，相传是周公测影的地方。元代在这里建起一座高台，台下一条长长的石圭，向正北伸去。
strings.scene.yuan.shoushi.end.legend: 石台还在，日影仍旧落在圭面上。遗迹与史书汇流。
strings.scene.yuan.shoushi.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若四海测验只设十处（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 元 · 元至元十六年（1279 年）。大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船。
setting.en: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1279 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

narration: 宋金以来沿用的旧历，已经和天象差了不少。江南平定后，世祖命郭守敬与王恂修订新历。郭守敬说：历之本在于测验，而测验之器莫先于仪表。太史院的旧浑仪是宋代从汴京运来的，早已不准。
他重新设计了简仪、仰仪、高表等十几种仪器。高表比旧表高出数倍，日影更加清楚。
至元十六年，他奏请在全国设二十七处观测点，南到南海，北到北海，同时测量。
数年间的数据汇到太史院，王恂一笔一笔地推算——
至元十七年冬新历告成，世祖赐名授时历，次年颁行。授时历以三百六十五日又二四二五为一岁，与今公历所用数值相同。

strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.title: 东方行纪
strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.subtitle: 马可·波罗
strings.vo.01: 一个威尼斯人在热那亚的监狱里，向同狱的作家讲述他在东方的经历。他说自己在大汗的朝廷里待了十七年。
strings.vo.02: 书中写到上都的宫殿、大都的街巷、驿站与纸币，写得绘声绘色，也有不少夸张与错误。
strings.vo.03: 中文史料里找不到马可·波罗这个名字。几百年来，人们一直争论他是否真的到过中国。
strings.vo.04: 一九四一年，一位学者在《永乐大典》的驿站公文中，读到至元二十七年的一条记录。
strings.vo.05: 记录里写着三个使臣的名字——
strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.anchor.quanzhou: 护送阔阔真自泉州启航
strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.pick.canon: 史料 · 汉文史料可以印证的部分
strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.canon.intro: 至元二十七年，大都。一份关于驿站口粮的公文送到了尚书省，说三位使臣要取道海路，往伊利汗国去。
strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.end.canon: 《永乐大典·站赤》所记兀鲁䚟、阿必失呵、火者三使，正与《行纪》所说护送公主西行的三位使臣相合。这条记录虽然没有提到马可·波罗，却说明他对这次航行的叙述有可靠的来源。
strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.pick.legend: 行纪 · 马可·波罗自述
strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.legend.disclaimer: 以下按《马可·波罗行纪》的自述改编。书中有些说法与史实不合，例如自称献炮攻破襄阳，而襄阳在他自述的到达年份之前已经降元；又自称在扬州做官三年，中文史料无可印证。
strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.legend.intro: 马可·波罗说：大汗很喜欢他，派他出使各地。他学会了几种语言，每次回来都给大汗讲沿途的奇闻。
strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.end.legend: 行纪里有夸张，也有真实的航程。两条线在泉州港汇流。
strings.scene.yuan.makebolo.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若找到马可·波罗的汉文记录（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 元 · 元至元十二年至二十九年（据其自述）（约 1275—1292 年）。大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船。

narration: 一个威尼斯人在热那亚的监狱里，向同狱的作家讲述他在东方的经历。他说自己在大汗的朝廷里待了十七年。书中写到上都的宫殿、大都的街巷、驿站与纸币，写得绘声绘色，也有不少夸张与错误。
中文史料里找不到马可·波罗这个名字。几百年来，人们一直争论他是否真的到过中国。
一九四一年，一位学者在《永乐大典》的驿站公文中，读到至元二十七年的一条记录。
记录里写着三个使臣的名字——
《永乐大典·站赤》所记兀鲁䚟、阿必失呵、火者三使，正与《行纪》所说护送公主西行的三位使臣相合。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Yuan dynasty (1271–1368) · "东方行纪" (马可·波罗)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1275 CE–1292 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

Characters:
- Kököchin (阔阔真) — royal / consort, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; age as historically attested in 1275 CE–1292 CE
- 兀鲁䚟 (兀鲁䚟) — commoner, 伊利汗国 camp; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots; age as historically attested in 1275 CE–1292 CE
- Marco Polo (马可·波罗) — commoner, 威尼斯 camp; period European dress appropriate to rank; elderly
- Kublai (忽必烈) — ruler, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 1275 CE–1292 CE
- A Luhun (阿鲁浑) — ruler, 伊利汗国 camp; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots; age as historically attested in 1275 CE–1292 CE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: grass, palace pillars, palace eaves | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 上都，草原上的宫城 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: horn | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「东方行纪」 with vermilion seal 「行纪」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; subject: war horse, banners | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 驿站相望，持牌使者驰马而过 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「一个威尼斯人在热那亚的监狱里，向同狱的作家讲述他在东方的经历。他说自己在大汗的朝廷里待了十七年。书中写到上都的宫殿、大都的街巷、驿站与纸币，写得绘声绘色，也有不少夸张与错误。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, gate; subject: crowd | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 汗八里城，街巷整齐如棋盘 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「中文史料里找不到马可·波罗这个名字。几百年来，人们一直争论他是否真的到过中国。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: sea, breaking waves, boat; subject: Kököchin | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 泉州港，十四艘四桅大船 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: sea waves; SFX: oars | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「一九四一年，一位学者在《永乐大典》的驿站公文中，读到至元二十七年的一条记录。」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: scroll; subject: 兀鲁䚟 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 一纸驿站公文上的三个名字 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: crashing waves, rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「记录里写着三个使臣的名字——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: 兀鲁䚟 | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 《永乐大典·站赤》所记兀鲁䚟、阿必失呵、火者三使，正与《行纪》所说护送公主西行的三位使臣相合。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「《永乐大典·站赤》所记兀鲁䚟、阿必失呵、火者三使，正与《行纪》所说护送公主西行的三位使臣相合。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「行纪」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: morin khuur horse-head fiddle, vast steppe mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, wind over open plains, crowd murmur, sea waves, quiet room tone; SFX: horn, hoofbeats, murmuring, oars, crashing waves, rustling silk; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「东方行纪」, subtitle 「马可·波罗」, vermilion seal 「行纪」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.title: 乌泥泾
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.subtitle: 黄道婆
strings.vo.01: 松江府东南的乌泥泾，土地贫瘠，种不好粮食，乡民就种木棉。可那时没有踏车和椎弓，只能用手剥去棉籽，用线弦竹弧弹花，费力又费时。
strings.vo.02: 据说一个叫黄道婆的女子，早年流落到海南崖州。崖州的黎族人很会纺织木棉。
strings.vo.03: 她在那里生活了几十年。元贞年间，她搭海船回到了故乡。
strings.vo.04: 她教乡人制作捍、弹、纺、织的工具，又教他们错纱、配色、综线、挈花的方法。
strings.vo.05: 不久之后，乌泥泾织出的被褥上——
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.quote: 乃教以做造捍、弹、纺、织之具，至于错纱、配色、综线、挈花，各有其法。
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.anchor.guixiang: 黄道婆自崖州归乌泥泾
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.pick.canon: 正史线 · 陶宗仪《南村辍耕录》与王逢《梧溪集》所载
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.canon.intro: 正史里没有她的名字，她的故事只记在一部元人笔记和一首诗里。可江南的衣被天下，从她开始。
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.end.canon: 乌泥泾所织的被褥，折枝、团凤、棋局、字样，粲然若写，人们竞相购买，号称“乌泥泾被”。不久黄道婆去世，乡人感恩洒泪，共同安葬了她，又为她立祠祭祀。松江从此成为全国棉纺织的中心。
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.pick.legend: 民间传说 · 逃出夫家
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.legend.disclaimer: 以下取上海、海南两地流传的黄道婆民间传说：她幼年做童养媳，不堪虐待，躲进一条海船逃到崖州；晚年思乡，冒险搭船北归。又有上海民谣“黄婆婆，黄婆婆，教我纱，教我布，二只筒子二匹布”。这些是后世传说与民谣，生平细节不见于元人记载。
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.legend.intro: 夜里，一个小姑娘从柴房的屋顶爬了出去，一直跑到黄浦江边，躲进了一条海船的船舱里。
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.end.legend: 传说给了她一个逃亡的开头，笔记给了她一个传艺的结尾。汇流。
strings.scene.yuan.huangdaopo.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若她留在崖州（未开放）

narration: 松江府东南的乌泥泾，土地贫瘠，种不好粮食，乡民就种木棉。可那时没有踏车和椎弓，只能用手剥去棉籽，用线弦竹弧弹花，费力又费时。据说一个叫黄道婆的女子，早年流落到海南崖州。崖州的黎族人很会纺织木棉。
她在那里生活了几十年。元贞年间，她搭海船回到了故乡。
她教乡人制作捍、弹、纺、织的工具，又教他们错纱、配色、综线、挈花的方法。
不久之后，乌泥泾织出的被褥上——
乌泥泾所织的被褥，折枝、团凤、棋局、字样，粲然若写，人们竞相购买，号称“乌泥泾被”。
乃教以做造捍、弹、纺、织之具，至于错纱、配色、综线、挈花，各有其法。

- 黎族织女（元·崖州黎人）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；女子衣着，依身份；年龄依史实（此时为约 1295 年）；以木棉纺织闻名
- 乌泥泾妇女（元·松江府）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；女子衣着，依身份；年龄依史实（此时为约 1295 年）；学会新法，以“乌泥泾被”著称

镜头 2（10–26 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：黎族织女、黄道婆｜动作：黎族妇女坐在竹楼下纺线，一个汉人女子在旁边学｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：鸟鸣；音效：织机｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「松江府东南的乌泥泾，土地贫瘠，种不好粮食，乡民就种木棉。可那时没有踏车和椎弓，只能用手剥去棉籽，用线弦竹弧弹花，费力又费时。据说一个叫黄道婆的女子，早年流落到海南崖州。崖州的黎族人很会纺织木棉。」
镜头 3（26–50 秒，24 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：江海、浪头、舟；主体：黄道婆｜动作：一只海船驶向北方，船头站着那个已经年老的女子｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：海浪；音效：摇橹｜屏幕文字：引文「乃教以做造捍、弹、纺、织之具，至于错纱、配色、综线、挈花，各有其法。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「她在那里生活了几十年。元贞年间，她搭海船回到了故乡。」
镜头 4（50–78 秒，28 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：乌泥泾妇女、众人｜动作：乌泥泾的村妇用手剥棉籽，竹弓弹花，又慢又累｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：弦断｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「她教乡人制作捍、弹、纺、织的工具，又教他们错纱、配色、综线、挈花的方法。」
镜头 5（78–90 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：黄道婆、乌泥泾妇女；飞白题字「衣被」｜动作：新造的三锭脚踏纺车转起来，布上织出了花纹｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：织机｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「不久之后，乌泥泾织出的被褥上——」
镜头 6（90–100 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：黄道婆、乌泥泾妇女｜动作：正史结局：乌泥泾所织的被褥，折枝、团凤、棋局、字样，粲然若写，人们竞相购买，号称“乌泥泾被”。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「乌泥泾所织的被褥，折枝、团凤、棋局、字样，粲然若写，人们竞相购买，号称“乌泥泾被”。」
镜头 7（100–106 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「乃教以做造捍、弹、纺、织之具，至于错纱、配色、综线、挈花，各有其法。」，下署《南村辍耕录·卷二十四 黄道婆》；右下角朱印「衣被」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「乃教以做造捍、弹、纺、织之具，至于错纱、配色、综线、挈花，各有其法。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：鸟鸣、海浪、寂静室内；音效：风声、织机、摇橹、弦断；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「乌泥泾」，副题「黄道婆」，朱印「衣被」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「乃教以做造捍、弹、纺、织之具，至于错纱、配色、综线、挈花，各有其法。」——《南村辍耕录·卷二十四 黄道婆》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

[Ink-wash video prompt] Yuan dynasty (1271–1368) · "乌泥泾" (黄道婆)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), c. 1295 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

Characters:
- Huang Daopo (黄道婆) — commoner, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in c. 1295 CE
- Li Zuzhinü (黎族织女) — commoner, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; female dress appropriate to rank; age as historically attested in c. 1295 CE
- Wu Nijingfunü (乌泥泾妇女) — commoner, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; female dress appropriate to rank; age as historically attested in c. 1295 CE

strings.scene.yuan.hongjin.title: 石人一只眼
strings.scene.yuan.hongjin.subtitle: 红巾军
strings.vo.01: 元末，黄河决口，泛滥连年。至正十一年，贾鲁奉命治河，征发民夫十余万。
strings.vo.02: 白莲教首领韩山童与刘福通暗中谋划起事。
strings.vo.03: 河工在黄陵冈挖出一尊独眼石人。民间传说，此前已有童谣：莫道石人一只眼，挑动黄河天下反。
strings.vo.04: 起事未成，韩山童被捕遇害。刘福通率众在颍州起事，头裹红巾。
strings.scene.yuan.hongjin.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.yuan.hongjin.canon.intro: 至正十一年四月，黄陵冈。十几万河工正在挖新河道，有人说，河南河北早就传着一首童谣。
strings.scene.yuan.hongjin.end.canon: 红巾军席卷中原。十余年后，出身红巾的朱元璋建立明朝，徐达攻入大都，元顺帝北走。
strings.scene.yuan.hongjin.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《元史》河渠志与五行志所载童谣、石人之事，并参照蔡东藩《元史演义》第五十四回。正史只记童谣在先、石人出土在后；石人是否有人预先埋下，史书不言，后世多为推测。本作只作谶语氛围处理。
strings.scene.yuan.hongjin.legend.intro: 至正十年，河南河北传唱一首童谣：石人一只眼，挑动黄河天下反。第二年，贾鲁开黄陵冈，河工在泥中挖到了一个独眼石人。
strings.scene.yuan.hongjin.end.legend: 石人出土，人心浮动。传说汇回正史：红巾起事。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 元 · 元至正十一年至二十八年（1351—1368 年）。大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船。
setting.en: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1351 CE–1368 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

characters.name: 刘福通
characters.zh: 刘福通（红巾·红巾军首领）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；年龄依史实（此时为1351—1368 年）；颍州起事，拥立韩林儿
characters.en: Liu Futong (刘福通) — general, 红巾 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; age as historically attested in 1351 CE–1368 CE

characters.name: 贾鲁
characters.zh: 贾鲁（元·工部尚书）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；年龄依史实（此时为1351—1368 年）；主持治理黄河
characters.en: Jia Lu (贾鲁) — minister, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 1351 CE–1368 CE

characters.name: 韩山童
characters.zh: 韩山童（红巾·白莲教首领）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；年龄依史实（此时为1351—1368 年）；与刘福通谋起事，被捕遇害
characters.en: Han Shantong (韩山童) — commoner, 红巾 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in 1351 CE–1368 CE

characters.name: 韩林儿
characters.zh: 韩林儿（红巾·小明王）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；少年（十余岁）；韩山童之子，被立为帝
characters.en: Han Liner (韩林儿) — royal / consort, 红巾 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; a teenager

characters.name: 朱元璋
characters.zh: 朱元璋（明·郭子兴部将，后之明太祖）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；年龄依史实（此时为1351—1368 年）；投红巾军，后建明朝
characters.en: Zhu Yuanzhang (朱元璋) — ruler, 明 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 1351 CE–1368 CE

shots.vo: 元末，黄河决口，泛滥连年。至正十一年，贾鲁奉命治河，征发民夫十余万。白莲教首领韩山童与刘福通暗中谋划起事。

shots.vo: 河工在黄陵冈挖出一尊独眼石人。民间传说，此前已有童谣：莫道石人一只眼，挑动黄河天下反。

shots.vo: 天下响应——

shots.vo: 红巾军席卷中原。十余年后，出身红巾的朱元璋建立明朝，徐达攻入大都，元顺帝北走。

sound.zh: 背景乐：马头琴，辽阔苍茫，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：洪水咆哮、人群低语、众人呐喊、火声；音效：夯土闷响、喊杀、众人呐喊；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: morin khuur horse-head fiddle, vast steppe mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: roaring flood, crowd murmur, roaring crowd, fire; SFX: thud of earth, war cries, roaring crowd; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「石人一只眼」，副题「红巾军」，朱印「红巾」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「石人一只眼」, subtitle 「红巾军」, vermilion seal 「红巾」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

narration: 元末，黄河决口，泛滥连年。至正十一年，贾鲁奉命治河，征发民夫十余万。白莲教首领韩山童与刘福通暗中谋划起事。
河工在黄陵冈挖出一尊独眼石人。民间传说，此前已有童谣：莫道石人一只眼，挑动黄河天下反。
起事未成，韩山童被捕遇害。刘福通率众在颍州起事，头裹红巾。
天下响应——
红巾军席卷中原。十余年后，出身红巾的朱元璋建立明朝，徐达攻入大都，元顺帝北走。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】元 · 石人一只眼（红巾军）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 106 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：卡其、深蓝，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。

时代与场景：元 · 元至正十一年至二十八年（1351—1368 年）。大都宫阙、草原毡帐、驿站、海船。

人物：
- 刘福通（红巾·红巾军首领）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；年龄依史实（此时为1351—1368 年）；颍州起事，拥立韩林儿
- 贾鲁（元·工部尚书）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；年龄依史实（此时为1351—1368 年）；主持治理黄河
- 韩山童（红巾·白莲教首领）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；年龄依史实（此时为1351—1368 年）；与刘福通谋起事，被捕遇害
- 韩林儿（红巾·小明王）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；少年（十余岁）；韩山童之子，被立为帝
- 朱元璋（明·郭子兴部将，后之明太祖）：蒙古质孙服、钹笠帽、辫发；汉人士人仍着宋式衣冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；年龄依史实（此时为1351—1368 年）；投红巾军，后建明朝

分镜：
镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：洪水｜动作：黄河决口，泛滥千里｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：洪水咆哮｜屏幕文字：片名「石人一只眼」竖排书法与朱印「红巾」
镜头 2（10–26 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：贾鲁、众人、毛笔｜动作：贾鲁治河，征发民夫十余万｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：夯土闷响｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元末，黄河决口，泛滥连年。至正十一年，贾鲁奉命治河，征发民夫十余万。白莲教首领韩山童与刘福通暗中谋划起事。」
镜头 3（26–50 秒，24 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：远景：皴法山石；中景：石人；主体：众人｜动作：河道中挖出一尊独眼石人｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：夯土闷响｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「河工在黄陵冈挖出一尊独眼石人。民间传说，此前已有童谣：莫道石人一只眼，挑动黄河天下反。」
镜头 4（50–78 秒，28 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：刘福通、军阵、长兵如林、红巾｜动作：颍州，红巾裹头｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：众人呐喊；音效：喊杀｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「起事未成，韩山童被捕遇害。刘福通率众在颍州起事，头裹红巾。」
镜头 5（78–90 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：火；飞白题字「红巾起」｜动作：天下反｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）；四角暗角收拢；热浪与烟气扭曲；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：火声；音效：众人呐喊｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「天下响应——」
镜头 6（90–100 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：红巾军席卷中原。十余年后，出身红巾的朱元璋建立明朝，徐达攻入大都，元顺帝北走。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「红巾军席卷中原。十余年后，出身红巾的朱元璋建立明朝，徐达攻入大都，元顺帝北走。」
镜头 7（100–106 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「红巾」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处

声音：背景乐：马头琴，辽阔苍茫，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：洪水咆哮、人群低语、众人呐喊、火声；音效：夯土闷响、喊杀、众人呐喊；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「石人一只眼」，副题「红巾军」，朱印「红巾」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Yuan dynasty (1271–1368) · "石人一只眼" (红巾军)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained khaki and deep blue accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Yuan dynasty (1271–1368), 1351 CE–1368 CE — Dadu palaces, steppe gers, relay stations, ocean junks.

Characters:
- Liu Futong (刘福通) — general, 红巾 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; age as historically attested in 1351 CE–1368 CE
- Jia Lu (贾鲁) — minister, 元 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in 1351 CE–1368 CE
- Han Shantong (韩山童) — commoner, 红巾 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in 1351 CE–1368 CE
- Han Liner (韩林儿) — royal / consort, 红巾 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; a teenager
- Zhu Yuanzhang (朱元璋) — ruler, 明 camp; Mongol jisun robes, bowl-shaped hats, braids; Han literati still in Song-style dress; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in 1351 CE–1368 CE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: flood waters | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 黄河决口，泛滥千里 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: roaring flood | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「石人一只眼」 with vermilion seal 「红巾」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Jia Lu, crowd, brush | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 贾鲁治河，征发民夫十余万 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: thud of earth | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元末，黄河决口，泛滥连年。至正十一年，贾鲁奉命治河，征发民夫十余万。白莲教首领韩山童与刘福通暗中谋划起事。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: background: textured rocks; midground: 石人; subject: crowd | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 河道中挖出一尊独眼石人 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: thud of earth | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「河工在黄陵冈挖出一尊独眼石人。民间传说，此前已有童谣：莫道石人一只眼，挑动黄河天下反。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Liu Futong, army ranks, forest of spears, 红巾 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 颍州，红巾裹头 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: war cries | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「起事未成，韩山童被捕遇害。刘福通率众在颍州起事，头裹红巾。」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: fire (splashed ink); dry-brush calligraphy 「红巾起」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 天下反 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: fire; SFX: roaring crowd | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「天下响应——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 红巾军席卷中原。十余年后，出身红巾的朱元璋建立明朝，徐达攻入大都，元顺帝北走。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「红巾军席卷中原。十余年后，出身红巾的朱元璋建立明朝，徐达攻入大都，元顺帝北走。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「红巾」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: morin khuur horse-head fiddle, vast steppe mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: roaring flood, crowd murmur, roaring crowd, fire; SFX: thud of earth, war cries, roaring crowd; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「石人一只眼」, subtitle 「红巾军」, vermilion seal 「红巾」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets
